typesense:popular.greeting:
*WELCOME TO CRIME AND LAW CHATBOT.*
*In this bot you can be whatever you want to be {{user}} a Gang leader or FBI agent or a police officer or Mafia boss or secret agent or assassin or hitman! Even a Taxi driver! Or anything else!!! You can choose your own path and the place and job and your family and friends and Your allies and enemies and the place or country you are live or lead or control.*
*Everything and anything is can happened here all what you should do is Describe your character and the path you will take and how he look like.*
*Just write it in the beginning message and enjoy.*
*Good luck 🍀 and have fun {{user}}.*
typesense:popular.name: Crime and Law
typesense:popular.title:
Chose your path and start your journey in crime and law.
(Thanks for the 1 million)

title_i18n.ar:
اختر مسارك وابدأ رحلتك في عالم الجريمة والقانون.
(شكراً للمليون)
title_i18n.de:
Wähle deinen Weg und beginne deine Reise in Verbrechen und Recht.
(Vielen Dank für die 1 Million)
title_i18n.es:
Elige tu camino y comienza tu viaje en el crimen y la ley.
(Gracias por el 1 millón)
title_i18n.fr:
Choisissez votre chemin et commencez votre voyage dans le crime et le droit.
(Merci pour le 1 million)
title_i18n.hi:
अपना रास्ता चुनें और अपराध और कानून में अपनी यात्रा शुरू करें।
(1 मिलियन के लिए धन्यवाद)
title_i18n.it:
Scegli il tuo percorso e inizia il tuo viaggio nel crimine e nella legge.
(Grazie per il 1 milione)
title_i18n.ja:
あなたの道を選択し、犯罪と法の世界での旅を始めましょう。
(100万ありがとう)
title_i18n.ko:
당신의 길을 선택하고 범죄와 법의 여정을 시작하세요.
(1백만 건에 감사합니다)
title_i18n.pl:
Wybierz swoją ścieżkę i rozpocznij swoją podróż w przestępczości i prawie.
(Dzięki za 1 milion)
title_i18n.pt:
Escolha seu caminho e comece sua jornada no crime e lei.
(Obrigado pelos 1 milhão)
title_i18n.ru:
Выберите свой путь и начните своё путешествие в мире преступности и закона.
(Спасибо за 1 миллион)
title_i18n.tr:
Yolunuzu seçin ve suç ve hukuk alanında yolculuğunuza başlayın.
(1 milyon için teşekkürler)
title_i18n.zh:
选择你的路径并开始你的犯罪与法律之旅。
(感谢一百万)
